description:
Build a house-and-terrain 3D demo using the same lead modeling agent as the hallway project. Preserve the hallway demo; keep each demo in a separate folder and share reusable tools. Read AGENTS.md and the existing model-evidence skill. Inspect the current React/TypeScript/Three.js workflow before choosing modeling/export tools; do not assume an existing Blender pipeline.

Sources: QARC New House Example 01 PDF https://qarcsystems.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/ARCBinder01_R2.pdf ; official examples https://qarcsystems.com.au/software-info/examples/ ; terms https://qarcsystems.com.au/terms-and-conditions/ . Actual PDF has 78 pages: 2-4 site/contours/levels, 5-6 floor plans, 16-17 elevations, 19 and 21-22 sections.

Model the house plus sloping terrain, driveway and relevant outbuildings from the drawings. Check dimensions and rendered views against sources; record measured, estimated and unknown geometry. Deliver reproducible source, useful preview views and a Blender-compatible export if feasible. This is an illustrative demo, not an engineering or as-built model.

QARC terms restrict reuse: resolve permission or propose a permitted replacement before reproducing or publishing the demo; do not contact rights holders without user authorization. Keep private original hallway media and location metadata out of this public repository. Claim this ticket in the existing Beadwork store and record progress, tests, artifacts and blockers. Same existing hallway modeling agent is responsible; current computer assignment is unconfirmed and should be recorded on pickup. WOOT posted this handoff at the user's request.

comments.text: Picked up on the current Windows laptop by the lead modeling agent on 2026-10-29 America/Denver. Restored the existing project and beadwork history from the transfer bundle, then fetched current tickets from origin. House demo first; hall-s3d remains untouched pending user testing of this ticket. QARC reuse permission is unresolved; user asked to choose an open-licensed replacement or confirm existing permission. Checking replacement sources and preparing the existing Three.js workflow; no QARC-derived geometry will be authored before source resolution.

Source review: QARC official examples describe viewing sample sets; current terms section 2 requires express written permission for reproduction/exploitation. No permission has been established. Proposed replacement: Australian Commonwealth Design For Place technical drawings, explicitly licensed CC BY 4.0 at https://www.yourhome.gov.au/copyright and available at https://www.yourhome.gov.au/house-designs . Telopea provides two-storey plans, sections, elevations and setout; any added sloping terrain would be an explicitly illustrative adaptation rather than a surveyed QARC site. Source selection question is pending with user. Existing React/TypeScript/Three.js runtime and GLTFExporter were inspected; isolated ticket worktree created and dependencies installed. No model geometry or published site changed. hall-s3d has not been started.

User has directed proceeding with the QARC example after reviewing the permission concern. No written permission is claimed. Scope is an attributed authored demo on the existing owner-private ChatGPT Site; do not add QARC-derived content to the public hallway repository. User now explicitly requests preserving terrain detail and maximizing model detail while remaining reasonably performant on a gaming laptop. Acceptance: preserve available contour/rock/drainage/graded-platform evidence, document interpolation limits, use practical mesh/instance budgets, verify rendered source comparisons and runtime, provide useful views and export, then stop for user testing before hall-s3d.

Implementation is in the existing owner-private Sites source, separate dist/house-terrain folder with shared Three.js viewer/model helpers. Dense terrain: 451x330 float32 grid (148830 stored vertices, <=0.45 m spacing), 37 labelled elevation anchors, 220 recovered contour segments / 19822 samples plus optional exact source-linework layer. House includes fanned wings, upper clerestory, room cutaway, openings/louvres/screens, seams/vents, curved north steps/rails, tanks, shed with 3 roller openings + personnel door and roof lights, future observatory, road/fence and shelf-zone detail. No hallway source changes. Compared rendered north/south/overall/cutaway against PDF 2-8, 16-18, 23 and 25. Corrected buried stairs, cladding joints crossing openings, stray rocks outside terrain and canvas layout. Four source/terrain regression checks pass; browser around 56 fps at a 1476x722 render target with roughly 339k triangles / 111 draw calls. GLB downloaded, header/records checked, and imported successfully in Blender 5.2.1 (1401 mesh objects, all 13 feature IDs). Publication remains pending; ticket stays open until deployed result verified.

title: Build house and terrain demo
